entities.name: Capitol Records Nashville
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
Capitol Records Nashville, established in 1989 as a dedicated country music imprint of Capitol Records, emerged from Capitol's earlier Nashville operations to become one of the most commercially successful country music labels in the industry — home to Garth Brooks (whose albums are among the best-selling of any artist in any genre in the history of recorded music), Kenny Rogers, Dierks Bentley, and Kacey Musgraves — and representing the mainstreaming of country music from regional American genre to billion-dollar global industry.

Capitol Nashville's founding coincided with the 'New Country' movement of the late 1980s and early 1990s: artists like Garth Brooks, Clint Black, and Alan Jackson who combined traditional country values with production values, arena-rock showmanship, and crossover appeal. Garth Brooks' career at Capitol Nashville — his self-titled debut (1989) through Ropin' the Wind (1991, the first country album to debut at #1 on the Billboard pop chart) through No Fences (1990, the best-selling country album of all time) — transformed country music from a regional genre into a mainstream American and eventually global phenomenon. Brooks became the best-selling solo American music artist of the RIAA certification era, ahead of Elvis and Michael Jackson in total certifications.

Modern Capitol Nashville continues with significant country artists; Kacey Musgraves' Golden Hour (2019) Grammy Album of the Year win for a country album marked the label's continued artistic credibility. Capitol Nashville is part of Universal Music Group Nashville and remains one of Nashville's most prestigious country imprints.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Capitol Records Nashville — home to Garth Brooks (America's best-selling solo artist), instrumental in country music's mainstream crossover, and producing Grammy Album of the Year winners — is one of the most commercially and culturally consequential country music labels ever established.
